entries.title: Silent together, restless apart
entries.odia: ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନ କହେ, ନ ଦେଖିଲେ ପାଣି ନ ପିଏ
entries.literal_meaning: On meeting, says nothing; without seeing, will not drink water.
entries.explanation: The contradiction is the joke: someone seems distant in person but cannot settle when the other is absent.
entries.meaning_odia: ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନାହିଁ, ନଦେଖିଲେ ମନ ଥୟ ନାହିଁ—ଏହି ବିରୋଧାଭାସକୁ କଥାଟି ଧରିଛି।
entries.usage_example: Two friends barely speak during a visit, then immediately ask when they will meet again. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The source labels this ଢଗ under meeting. It names no relationship or reason for the silence.

entries.title: Two errands on one trip
entries.odia: ହାଟକୁ ଗଲେ କନ୍ୟା ଦେଖିବି ବାଇଗଣ ବିକିବି ଦି କାମ କରିବି
entries.literal_meaning: At the market I will look for a bride and sell brinjals: I will do two tasks.
entries.explanation: One outing is made to serve two purposes. The unexpected pairing gives the plan its humour.
entries.meaning_odia: ଗୋଟିଏ ଥର ଯିବାରେ ଦୁଇଟି କାମ ସାରିବାର ଯୋଜନା। କାମ ଦୁଇଟିର ଅଲଗା ସ୍ୱଭାବରେ ମଜା ଅଛି।
entries.usage_example: Someone collects a repaired bicycle while returning a borrowed book nearby. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary places this under seeking. It does not establish a marriage custom or imply buying a bride.
